name: eon
description: Eon MCP server — exposes the Eon AI agent tools and skills for multi-cloud backup, recovery, inventory, and onboarding.

interface.shortDescription: Multi-cloud backup, recovery, and inventory management via the Eon AI agent.
interface.longDescription: Connect to the Eon MCP server to manage cloud backup and recovery across AWS, Azure, and GCP. Includes 27 tools for source account management, resource inventory, backup policies, snapshot browsing, restore jobs, GCP organization/folder onboarding, and resource discovery. Guided skills walk you through complex workflows like GCP cloud account onboarding.
